Apne buland-tareen Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh karo
Jis ne paida kiya hai aur durust banaaya hai
Jis ne taqdeer mu'ayyan ki hai aur phir hidaayat di hai
Phir use khushk kar ke siyaah rang ka koda bana diya hai
Hum anqareeb tumhein is tarah padhaayenge ke bhool na sakoge
Magar yeh ke Khuda hi chaahe, ke woh har zaahir aur makhfi rehne waali cheez ko jaanta hai
Aur hum tum ko aasaan raaste ki taufeeq denge
Lihaaza logon ko samjhaao agar samjhaane ka faaida ho
Anqareeb khauf-e-Khuda rakhne waala samajh jaaega
Aur badbakht us se kinaara-kashi karega
Jo bahut badi aag mein jalne waala hai
Phir na us mein zindagi hai na maut
Beshak paakeeza rehne waala kaamyaab ho gaya
Jis ne apne Rab ke naam ki tasbeeh ki aur phir namaaz padhi
Lekin tum log zindagaani-e-duniya ko muqaddam rakhte ho
Jab ke aakhirat behtar aur hamesha rehne waali hai
Yeh baat tamaam pehle saheefon mein bhi maujood hai
Ibraheem alaihis-salaam ke saheefon mein bhi aur Moosa alaihis-salaam ke saheefon mein bhi
